notes.title: Exciting Upcoming Update
notes.content:
We are thrilled to share some exciting news about our upcoming update for Controlled Death! Based on your valuable feedback, we've been hard at work to bring you new features and improvements to enhance your gameplay experience. Here's what you can look forward to in the next update:

[list]
[*] Reporting System: Introducing a custom Player Report system, empowering players to combat cheaters and maintain a fair gaming environment. With the custom Player Report system, you can manually submit reports of suspected hackers/cheaters in the game by simply clicking over the player name in the player scoreboard, selecting the Report option, and submitting the report.

[*] More Weapons: Expand your arsenal with an array of new and exciting weapons:
[*] 2 Rifles
[*] 2 Pistols
[*] 2 Sniper Rifles
[*] 2 SMGs
[*] 2 Shotguns
[*] 1 LMG
[*] 1 Grenade Gun
[*] 1 Knife

[*] Hopefully Fixed Vehicles: We've addressed numerous vehicle-related bugs and issues. We're optimistic that your vehicle experience will be smoother and more reliable.

[*] Cleaner UI: Enjoy a more streamlined and user-friendly interface, making navigation and gameplay more intuitive.
[/list]

Stay tuned for more details and the release date. We can't wait for you to experience all the new features and improvements on the battlefield!

Thank you for your continued support and feedback.

Happy gaming!
